The fight reaches its brutal climax! KIBORG: Descent is the large expansion that brings to the game new difficulty modes, locations, enemies, and weapons. 

Three Circles of Hell: Infiltrate the flooded ruins of an ancient civilization, survive the death conveyor of an abandoned KENKOU factory, and defy the darkness in realms that resemble damnation itself.
The Evolution of Terror: Face over 10 new horrors from the depths, 3 legendary bosses from the KIBORG lore, and devious new traps that will break your familiar routines.

The Abyss of Challenge: 2 new difficulty levels for true masters. Here, every enemy is smarter, meaner, and deadlier.

The Reckoning: The hour for long-overdue confrontations has come. The chance to finally beat Volkov to a pulp is just the beginning.

The descent begins now.

Now available in Pinball FX!

Relive the golden age of pinball with Williams™ Pinball Volume 10. This amazing collection brings together the iconic Diner™ pinball table with the first ever official recreation of Fire!™ and Comet™. 

This pack features:

Comet™: Ride the rails of a carnival classic! Race around the Comet Ramp, and chase high scores under the glow of flashing midway lights. 

Fire!™: Sound the alarm! Race against time to put out fires and rescue victims across a unique mirrored playfield, glowing with the heat of action.

Diner™: Step into the charm of a classic American diner. Collect the D-I-N-E-R lights by serving cranky customers to unlock Dine-Time for massive scores.
